yt.intro: Today, we will watch a video produced by Gavin, from the Youtube Channel Small Advantages. Gavin is an American guy that learned Portuguese by himself. In his channel, he gives tips about the English language and culture. Today, we'll take a look at a part of his video about PRONUNCIATION of the 'LL sound.

video.instrucao: Every time the word PRACTICE appears, repeat the sentence on the screen. Pay attention to your pronunciation!

discussao: Do you know this Youtube Channel?
b. No, I don't know it.
What's your opinion about his Portuguese?
In my opinion it is... funny / nice / correct / incorrect / other
conversa: Do you watch videos on Youtube?
How often do you watch them?
Which kind of videos do you watch?
Is it easy or difficult for you to pronounce the 'LL sound?
Do you watch videos online to study?

pratica.instrucao: Teacher, make sure every student is familiar with the auxiliary WILL and its CONTRACTION form. If necessary, explore this structure on the board.
Ask different students to act out the dialogs. Give the student time to come up with answers to fill in the blanks. Pay attention to the pronunciation of the contractions!
itens: A: What will you have for dinner?
A: Where do you think she'll go?
B: I guess she'll probably go to ______ .
B: No, I don't. But I'll do it someday.
A: When will they start the project?

avaliacao: What did you like about today's activity?
I liked the... VIDEO / GAMES / CONVERSATION
